name: @estoc/vault
description: The .estoc vault format as code: the on-disk contract (docs/vault-format.md) every Estoc client reads and writes — config and seed keystore singletons, contact and invitation records, append-only message and delivery logs, blobs — over a pluggable VaultBackend (OPFS in the browser, a folder on disk in Node, memory for tests), with snapshot and merge-import. Format only: what a DID is minted as is the caller's.
author: merely
